prompt: Regarding computational complexity analysis: Populating a binary heap of n elements using Floyd's bottom-up buildHeap algorithm versus n sequential heap insertions. Which of the following correctly characterizes the complexity?
options: buildHeap is O(n log n), sequential is O(n)
buildHeap is O(n), sequential insertion is O(n log n)
explanation: Floyd's algorithm computes sum_{h=0}^{log n} (n / 2^{h+1}) * O(h) which converges to O(n). In contrast, inserting n elements one-by-one into a heap can take up to sum log(i) = O(n log n).
